# Context: codec-archive

Codec pipeline (filters + zstd, Encoder / Decoder) and the `.jix` archive format.
Ref convention: `codec/...`, `archive/...`, `storage/...`, `util/...`, `ops/...`, `array/...`,
`context.rs`, `dtype.rs`, `error.rs`, `lib.rs` are under `jix/src/`; `jix-py/...` is written in full.
Inside the archive sections, `array.rs`, `block.rs`, `common.rs`, `version.rs`,
`schema/conversions.rs` mean `archive/<file>`.

## Purpose

- `Encoder` (`codec/mod.rs:102-204`): runs the filter chain on one raw block, then zstd;
  `encode_bound` sizes the output. `Decoder` (`:246-324`): zstd into `dst` (or a pooled tmp), checks
  the decoded length, then runs the filters in reverse. `ReadContext` moved out of codec in #98: it
  now lives in `context.rs:51-97` (zstd `Decompressor` in an `UnsafeCell`, a `BufferPool`, and the new
  block/region read cache) - not part of this subsystem, but `Decoder` borrows its
  `pub(crate) decompressor` / `buffer_pool` fields.
- Filters (#98 flattened `codec/filter/` into `codec/filter.rs`, `codec/byte_shuffle.rs`,
  `codec/bit_shuffle.rs`): `ByteShuffle` (SIMD via `fearless_simd` for itemsize 2/4/8/16, scalar
  otherwise) and `BitShuffle` (3 passes: byte shuffle, 8x8 bit transpose + scatter, row swap; trailing
  `N mod 8` elements copied verbatim).
- Archive: `ArchiveWriter` / `ArchiveReader` (`common.rs`), block-table (de)serialization
  `BlockArchiveWriter`, `BlockTable::read_content`, `BlockTableStorageRead` for `Owned` (heap) and
  `Mmap` (`block.rs`), the public `Array::read_from_file / read_from_file_with / read_from /
  read_from_file_mmap / write_to_file / write_to` plus the header checks (`array.rs`),
  `Dtype::{from_proto,to_proto}` (`schema/conversions.rs`), the version word (`version.rs`).

Wire layout of one ArrayV1 archive (offsets relative to `base_offset` = writer position at start):
`"jix1"` | uleb128-len `FileMetadata{archive_type, lib_version_semver}` | uleb128-len
`ArrayHeader{shape:u64[], block_shape:u64[]}` | uleb128-len `BlockTableHeader{dtype, nitems,
block_size, codec, filters, ContiguousV1}` | TOC `[Section;2]` (raw 32 bytes, `{offset:i64, size:u64}`
for blocks_loc then block_data) | blocks_loc: `nblocks * 12` bytes, packed `{offset:u64 LE, len:u32 LE}`
(`storage/block.rs:26-32`, alignment 1, NO padding since #87) | block_data (compressed blocks in any
order). Readers locate sections only through the TOC (`block.rs:98-105`, `block.proto` comment).

## Contracts

Provided by the codec:
- `Encoder::encode(data, dst)` (`codec/mod.rs:139`): errors if `data.len() % itemsize != 0`
  (`:145-149`); needs `dst.len() >= encode_bound(data.len())` (zstd errors otherwise). Under
  `cfg(miri)` `encode_bound(n) == n` and `dst.copy_from_slice(data)` (`:186`) PANICS unless the lengths
  are equal; both callers pass exactly `encode_bound` bytes (`array/compact.rs:327-330`,
  `storage/block.rs:374-393`). Returns the compressed length.
- `Decoder::decode(src, dst) -> Result<()>` (`codec/mod.rs:251`): decompresses into `dst` directly
  (no filters) or into a pooled tmp (`:273-276`); `ensure!(nbytes == dst_len, InvalidArchive)`
  (`:310-314`) BEFORE any filter runs (K1/K17 fixed, test `:349-365`). On error `dst` may hold partial
  zstd output (no filters / even filter count) but never filter output. zstd errors if the output
  would exceed `dst`. Caller must give `dst.len() % itemsize == 0` (all callers pass whole blocks:
  `storage/block.rs:197-207`).
- `Filter::encode/decode(src, dst, dtype, pool)` (`codec/filter.rs:32-46`): `src.len() == dst.len()`
  asserted in release (`byte_shuffle.rs:28,136`, `bit_shuffle.rs:102,154`); byte shuffle also
  asserts `len % itemsize == 0`; bit shuffle accepts any length. `itemsize > 0` is NOT checked
  (division by zero at `byte_shuffle.rs:118,210`, `bit_shuffle.rs:104,156`); it is established for
  arrays by `tune` -> `check_dtype_size_nonzero` (`storage/params.rs:290`, `error.rs:176`). Both filters
  write every byte of `dst` (the Encoder relies on this) and decode is the exact inverse of encode.
- `MAX_FILTERS = 4` (`codec/mod.rs:217`); `EncoderParams::level` must fit i8 (`:69-77`).

Relied on from other modules:
- `AlternatingBuffers` (`util/mod.rs:296-396`): `new(a, b)` starts Alternating; the first `edit`
  returns `(a, b)`. Decoder parity (`codec/mod.rs:263-281`) puts `dst` second for an even filter count
  so the last write lands in `dst`; only a `debug_assert` checks it (`:294`).
- `BlockTable` (`storage/block.rs`): `new` (`:115-139`) only `debug_assert`s `blocks_loc.len() ==
  nblocks` (`:127`); `block_bytes` (`:163-176`) range-checks every location on access (K149, #93), so
  bad locations in a Minimal-validated file give `InvalidArchive`, not a panic; `read_block`
  (`:190-210`) checks `buf.len() == block_size * itemsize`. The single-block fast path of the compact
  read (`storage/compact.rs:344-354`) hands the CALLER'S out buffer to `Decoder::decode` as `dst`.
- `ArrayBlockTableStorageBase::new` (`storage/compact.rs:190-223`): spec block shape must match the
  block geometry; only `debug_assert`ed (`:210-221`). The reader guarantees it by tuning with every
  dim fixed (`array.rs:552-558`). `new` also assigns a fresh `ArrayCacheId` (cache is new since #95/#98).
- `ArrayParams::tune` (`storage/params.rs:282-413`) gives the archive its size bounds on BOTH paths:
  itemsize > 0, dims <= i64::MAX and byte size fits u64 (`check_shape_overflow`, `error.rs:192`),
  block bytes <= `BLOCK_SIZE_BYTES_MAX = 2^30` (`lib.rs:432`, `params.rs:369-378`), padded product
  fits u64 (`:418-427`). This is why `compressed.len() as u32` (`block.rs:204`,
  `storage/block.rs:317`) cannot truncate (`compress_bound(2^30) < 2^32`) and why the per-block
  buffer fits usize on 32-bit (K18/K24 fixed).
- `compact_into_builder` (`array/compact.rs:121-351`) must emit every block index in `0..nblocks`
  exactly once; `BlockArchiveWriter` checks neither duplicates nor gaps (an unwritten index stays
  `(0, 0)`, which now decodes to a clean length error).
- `core::io::Take: Seek` (std >= 1.89, = MSRV): positions are relative to the Take start (= archive
  base) and bounded by the initial limit; `seek_relative_to_base` (`common.rs:255-262`) relies on it.
- prost: default recursion limit (100) bounds nested dtype decoding (~3 prost levels per dtype level,
  so ~33 dtype levels; the writer caps at `DTYPE_NESTING_MAX = 32`, `block.rs:134-138`, K128);
  unknown enum values read back as `Unspecified`; unknown oneof members give `None`; unknown fields
  are skipped silently; invalid UTF-8 field names are a decode error.

Archive validation (untrusted input). Always (O(1) or bounded by the input size):
- `ArchiveReader::new`: `len >= 4`, magic (`common.rs:118-131`); uleb128 capped at 10 bytes
  (`:184-189`, K55); message bytes read with `take(len).read_to_end` (`:210-225`, grows as it reads,
  K47); archive type (`array.rs:456-463`); `ndim <= 8` (`:483`); every dim `<= i64::MAX` (`:485-489`,
  K100); `block_shape.len() == ndim`; `0 < b <= max(s,1) && b <= u32::MAX` BEFORE the cast
  (`:496-507`, K102); padded nitems fits u64 (zero dims counted as 1, `util/mod.rs:224-234`) and block
  product fits u32 (`:509-536`); `nblocks` product cannot overflow given those (`:537-541`).
- `read_content` (`block.rs:308-426`): codec present/known, `<= 4` filters all known, body
  description present; each section `offset >= 0 && offset + size <= total_size` with checked math
  (`common.rs:264-274`, K46; `total_size = len.unwrap_or(u64::MAX)`), `size % size_of::<T>() == 0`;
  Owned: `usize::try_from` (`block.rs:450`) and chunked growth (`:458-465`, K48/K56); Mmap: also
  `base_offset + offset + size <= mmap.len()` (`:497-503`, K5) and pointer alignment (`:506-510`,
  always true now that T has alignment 1); `block_size = BlockSize::try_from(..) > 0` (`:377-380`),
  `nitems % block_size == 0`, `blocks_loc.len() == nblocks` (`:381-393`).
- Then (`array.rs:530-558`) block table vs header (block_size, nitems, nblocks) and `tune` via
  `ArrayBlockTableStorageBase::new` (itemsize > 0, byte size fits u64, block bytes <= 2^30).
- `Dtype::from_proto` (`schema/conversions.rs:9-128`): alignment pow2 <= 32768, itemsize fits u16,
  dtype shape ndim <= 8 here then <= 4 in `set_shape`, dims fit u16, product (u16) nonzero; scalar:
  kind / little-endian / alignment / itemsize; struct (`dtype.rs:569-706`): offsets fit u16, nested
  dtypes recursively, `check_fields` (dense layout in offset order, no padding, no duplicate names,
  checked u16 sums, nesting <= 32), alignment either a valid aligned layout or 1 (packed).
- Strict only (`block.rs:394-412`): every block's `(offset, len)` lies inside block_data.
Trusted / NOT validated: compressed block contents beyond zstd's frame checks and the decoded length;
`lib_version_semver`; section placement (sections may overlap each other or the headers; only bounds
are checked); uniqueness / overlap of block ranges; caller `len` vs the real file length for Owned
reads (a short file just hits EOF).

Unsafe fns with preconditions:
- `pub unsafe fn Array::read_from_file_mmap` (`array.rs:225`): documented precondition only "file not
  modified (in or out of process) while mapped" (`:203-209`). Section ranges are now checked against
  the mapping, so a wrong caller `len` is no longer a memory-safety issue. Truncating the file while
  mapped is SIGBUS (covered by the doc). Python exposes it as safe `read_array(..., mmap=True)`
  (`jix-py/src/archive.rs:120-122`) with a docstring caution (`:38-40`).
- `util::value_from_io` / `value_as_bytes` / `cast_slice{,_mut}` (`util/mod.rs:198-218,564-610`): T
  must be padding-free POD valid for every bit pattern. Used with `Header`, `[Section;2]`,
  `BlockLocation` (repr(C) / packed, no padding) - holds.
- `BlockTableStorageRead::read_section<T: Copy>` (`block.rs:39-46`, not `unsafe`): reinterprets
  file bytes as T; sound only for POD T (callers use `u8`, `BlockLocation`).

## Unsafe inventory

- `codec/mod.rs:153,166` `AlignedBytes::set_len(data.len())` after `clear()+reserve()` exposes uninit
  bytes as the filters' `&mut [u8]` dst. Relies on every filter writing every dst byte before reading
  it (true today; non-local: a new filter or an early return breaks it). Creating `&mut [u8]` over
  uninit memory is itself the latent pattern of K124.
- `codec/mod.rs:285` `&mut *self.inner.get()` on the context's decompressor: relies on `ReadContext`
  being `!Sync` (UnsafeCell / RefCell fields; `Send` is const-asserted `context.rs:93-96`), on the
  `&mut` not outliving `decompress_to_buffer`, and on zstd never re-entering jix. `Decoder` holds
  `&ReadContext`, so it is `!Send`.
- `codec/mod.rs:261` (safe call of `PoolBuf::as_mut_slice`, `util/buf_pool.rs:114-117`): the tmp may be
  uninit / stale; zstd writes `nbytes`, and the length check at `:310-314` now guarantees the filters
  only read bytes zstd wrote. Established locally.
- `byte_shuffle.rs:78,107` (encode SIMD) and `:176,195` (decode SIMD) `get_unchecked`: bounds follow
  from `i + lanes <= nchunks*lanes <= nitems` and the asserts `:54,162`. `:128-129,216-217` scalar /
  tail: `i < nitems`, `b < itemsize`, dst asserted at `:123,211`; `len % itemsize == 0` is only
  `debug_assert`ed there (`:120,208`) but asserted by the only entry points (`:28,136`). Local.
- `bit_shuffle.rs`, `filter.rs`: no unsafe (safe indexing; a bug panics).
- `common.rs:46`, `block.rs:168,218,235` `value_as_bytes` / `cast_slice` of POD headers and the
  locations: fine (`size_of::<BlockLocation>() == 12`, const assert `storage/block.rs:32`).
- `common.rs:125`, `block.rs:349-351` `value_from_io` (zero-initialized buffer, K4 fixed);
  `block.rs:460-461` `cast_slice_mut` over zero-filled `MaybeUninit<T>`; `:466-469`
  `Vec::from_raw_parts` of the same allocation (K63 fixed).
- `block.rs:502-512` Mmap: `mmap[offset..].as_ptr()` + `SendSyncPtr::new` + `len = size /
  size_of::<T>()`; later `slice::from_raw_parts` in `MmapData::as_ref` (`storage/block.rs:452`).
  Needs `[offset, offset+size)` inside the mapping (checked `:497-503`) and the mapping alive
  (`Arc` clone `:513`) and unmodified (caller contract). Non-local only through the file contract.
- `array.rs:233` `memmap2::Mmap::map`: precondition forwarded to the caller of `read_from_file_mmap`.
- Consult: `storage/block.rs:229` `assert_unchecked_eq!(element_type.dtype(), decoder dtype)`, used by
  `write_content` (`block.rs:82`); established by `ET::from_dtype` in `BlockTable::new` (`:128`) and
  `element_type_change` (`:240`), with `ElementType` sealed (K70).

## Edge-case surface

- Zero-length dims: header must have `b == 1` there (`array.rs:487`); nitems 0, nblocks 0, empty
  sections; Mmap with `offset == mmap.len()` and size 0 is fine. 0-d (`shape []`): empty products give
  nitems 1, block_size 1, nblocks 1 on both the write (`array.rs:430`) and read paths.
- Partial edge blocks are written zero-padded (`array/compact.rs:301-304`); the archive always stores
  full blocks (padded nitems, `array.rs:495-511`).
- Itemsize is u16. An empty struct (itemsize 0) passes `from_proto` and is rejected later by `tune`
  (UnsupportedDtype); zero-size FIELDS inside a non-empty struct pass `check_fields` (consumers such as
  `SubDtype` re-check, `ops/sub_dtype.rs:60`). The unused `BlockTable::read_from` (`block.rs:270`)
  skips `tune` entirely. Odd itemsizes (3, 5, 12, struct / inner shape) use the scalar byte-shuffle
  path and the generic bit-shuffle math.
- Bit shuffle with `n < 8`: `full_bytes == 0`, everything is tail; tmp of size 0 from the pool.
- bool8 / f16 / complex: `ScalarKind` variants are not feature-gated, so files load as `TypeDyn`
  regardless of features. bool8 accepts any byte by design (K44 fixed by #89).
- Large sizes / 32-bit: reader conversions are checked (`block.rs:450`, `storage/block.rs:163`); Mmap
  `section.size as usize` (`block.rs:493`) is computed before the bounds check but only used after it.
  Writer: `nitems = nblocks * block_size` (`block.rs:133`), `nblocks * 12` (`:172`),
  `vec![..; nblocks as usize]` (`:184`, same in `storage/block.rs:288`), `block_index as usize`
  (`:205`) are unchecked; nblocks is bounded only by "padded product fits u64".
- Truncated / short input: Owned -> `UnexpectedEof`; `len=None` -> `total_size = u64::MAX`, sections
  are read until EOF (bounded by the real stream, test `array.rs:729-756`).
- Error kinds: truncation, bad uleb128 and protobuf decode failures surface as `ErrorKind::Io`
  (`common.rs:140-163` -> `.map_err(Error::io)`, `error.rs:43`; Python `OSError`,
  `jix-py/src/util.rs:93`); structural problems as `InvalidArchive` (Python `RuntimeError`); `tune`
  rejections of a file as `InvalidArgument` / `InvalidShapeOperation` / `UnsupportedDtype`.
- Multiple arrays per file: Section offsets are relative to `base_offset` (`block.rs:220-229`); after a
  read the reader is left at the max section end (`block.rs:357-365`, K131) so back-to-back archives
  read in sequence (test `array.rs:586`). mmap works at any file offset (test `:1311`).
- Version: `VERSION_U64` written (`common.rs:48-51`), never read; `build_metadata` is always 0
  (`version.rs:6`); `parse_pre_release` maps "rc.0" to 0 = stable (`version.rs:107-129`, compile-time
  only). Forward compat relies on unknown enums / oneofs turning into clean errors
  (`schema/conversions.rs:59-75`, `block.rs:320-344,371-374`); unknown new fields are ignored silently.
  `todo.md:6` "document archive compatibility".
- Aliasing: filter src/dst are distinct by construction (`AlternatingBuffers` holds two `&mut`); bit
  shuffle uses its own pooled tmp; `Decoder` may write straight into the caller's out buffer (fast path
  above), which is contiguous by that path's check.

## Intentional behaviors

- `ArchiveValidation::Minimal` skips the per-block location scan; it is for trusted files
  (`archive/mod.rs:8-31`, Python docstring `jix-py/src/archive.rs:17-42`). Since K149 (#93) a bad
  location is still a clean error at access time. The enum doc now says "every block's `(offset, len)`
  lies within the data section" (#94); blocks may be stored in ANY order (`block.rs:401-402`).
- `read_from(len=None)` skips section bounds checks (`array.rs:115-121`).
- Read `params` never change the loaded data: block shape comes from the file, blocks decode with the
  file's codec; params only seed derived arrays and steer read behavior (docs `array.rs:72-72`,
  `:128-133`; Python `jix-py/src/archive.rs:34-37`; K148). The caller's `block_shape_fixed_dims` is
  stored back as a hint only (`array.rs:552-567`, test `:711`; K43 fixed). The caller's `block_size`
  is kept in the spec as-is.
- `write_to` on a compact source copies compressed blocks and ignores `params` (`array.rs:344-344`,
  tests `:1133`, `:1426` for view / any / typed wrappers). New since #95: identity `Slice` / `Roll` /
  `Flip` views also forward `as_compact` (`ops/shape_ops/slice.rs:120-122,235-241`,
  `roll.rs:74-76,172-178`, `flip.rs:79-81,191-197`), so they take the same copy path.
- `write_to_file` uses `create_new` (fails if the file exists, test `array.rs:1165`) and removes the
  partial file on error (`:333-344`, K146). `write_to` into an append-mode writer returns an error
  (`block.rs:237-243`, test `array.rs:758`, K49). Python append mode opens without O_APPEND and seeks
  to the end on purpose (`jix-py/src/archive.rs:243-265`).
- API renames in #94 (`read_from_file(path)` without params, `read_from_file_with`, `read_from`,
  `write_to(writer, params, ctx)` replacing `write_to_with`) are deliberate.
- Any filter combination (e.g. ByteShuffle then BitShuffle) is allowed (`codec/mod.rs:87-87`).
- Byte shuffle of itemsize 1 is a memcpy; the bit-shuffle tail is copied verbatim
  (`bit_shuffle.rs:82-83`).
- Big-endian targets / dtypes unsupported (compile-time asserts `bit_shuffle.rs:340-345`,
  `storage/block.rs:10-15`; big-endian dtype rejected `schema/conversions.rs:66-68`).
- `cfg(miri)` replaces zstd by memcpy (`codec/mod.rs:111-114,135-136,183-188,201-204,305-309`); the
  short-decode test is `#[cfg_attr(miri, ignore)]` (`:350`).
- Packed struct dtypes (alignment 1 with wider fields at unaligned offsets) load fine; padding is
  forbidden (#88), duplicate names rejected (K52).
- Note: the Python bindings in this environment are a DEBUG build (overflow checks on); shipped wheels
  are release (no `overflow-checks` override in `jix/Cargo.toml`), so overflow panics seen in tests
  are silent wraps in production.

## Hot spots

New or changed since 6dbeb15 (the next hunt concentrates here):
- [NEW, #95] `write_to`'s compact copy path (`array.rs:407-416`) now also runs for identity
  `Slice` / `Roll` / `Flip` views. It writes `self.shape()` with the INNER block shape and blocks. Is
  every `is_identity` exactly "same shape, same element order"? Slice: `no_steps && shape ==
  inner shape` (`slice.rs:120-122`); Roll: shift normalized to `[0, len)` (`roll.rs:50-54`) and `== 0`;
  Flip: no flipped dims (dims of size 0/1 are skipped at construction, `flip.rs:45-61`). Also
  `MaybeCompact::as_compact` = `Some(compact.unwrap())` (`ops/maybe_compact.rs:101-107`): can it now
  see an `Original` whose `as_compact()` is `None`?
- [CHANGED, #94] `array.rs` API rename / merge: `write_to_file` now passes `ArrayParams::default()` and
  `self.read_ctx()` (`:335`); `read_from_file` hard-codes default params (`:47-56`). Any behavior
  drift vs the old `write_to_with` / `read_from_file_section`? Python call sites:
  `jix-py/src/archive.rs:115-122,149,296-307`.
- [MOVED, #98] `ReadContext` -> `context.rs`; `Decoder` reads `context.decompressor` /
  `context.buffer_pool` directly (`codec/mod.rs:244,275,319`). The context now also caches decoded
  regions keyed by `ArrayCacheId` (`context.rs:104-290`). Can a cached `PoolBufShared` and the
  Decoder / bit-shuffle tmp buffers from the same `BufferPool` alias, or can `decode` run re-entrantly
  while the decompressor `&mut` is live?
- [MOVED, #98] `codec/filter/*` -> `codec/{filter,byte_shuffle,bit_shuffle}.rs` (99% similar, only
  paths / visibility changed): low priority unless visibility now lets a caller skip the entry asserts.

Older code, still worth a look:
- Writer sizes: `BlockArchiveWriter::start` multiplies and allocates from `nblocks` unchecked
  (`block.rs:133,172,184`). A lazy array with a huge shape and small blocks (e.g. a broadcast u8 of
  shape `[2^62]`, block `[1]`) passes `tune`; does `write_to` then panic or abort instead of erroring?
- SIMD byte shuffle (`byte_shuffle.rs:48-108,160-200`): the interleave / deinterleave rounds are
  correct only if `fearless_simd` zips the FULL vector (not per 128-bit lane) for u8x32 / u8x64. Tests
  cover only the host's levels (`:291-381`, K151); NEON and `Fallback` are not run on x86. Does the
  scalar tail start exactly at `n_elements_done`?
- Encode vs decode agreement: Decoder buffer parity for 1..4 filters; bit-shuffle forward
  (`bit_shuffle.rs:188-252`) vs inverse (`:277-333`) for non-power-of-two typesize and `n % 8 != 0`.
- `seek_relative_to_base` (`common.rs:255-262`) with `len=None`: end offset saturates at `i64::MAX`
  (`block.rs:358-360`) and is handed to `BufReader::seek_relative` / a Python `seek`; any panic path?
- Read params: the caller's `block_size` survives into the spec while the block shape is the file's
  (`array.rs:552-558`, `params.rs:311-314,428-437`); does any consumer assume `spec.block_size() ==
  prod(block_shape) * itemsize`?
- Struct dtypes from files: zero-size fields, packed layouts with unaligned wide fields, nesting
  exactly 32 (`array.rs:608`): do consumers of field offsets (`ops/sub_dtype.rs`) handle all three?

### Suspicions (unverified)

- [CONFIRMED in batch7-2 as K160] `archive/block.rs:172,184` (and `storage/block.rs:288`) - `nblocks * 12` and
  `vec![..; nblocks as usize]` unchecked: `write_to` / `compact` of a cheap lazy array with a huge
  padded shape panics (debug overflow / capacity overflow) or aborts on allocation failure instead of
  returning an error; on 32-bit `as usize` truncates (then an index panic). Low.
- `archive/common.rs:161-162` + `archive/array.rs:456,481` - malformed protobuf / truncated headers
  are reported as `ErrorKind::Io` (Python `OSError`) while other malformed-archive cases are
  `InvalidArchive`; inconsistent error class for the same "corrupt file" condition. Low.

## Review units

1. `codec-archive-codec-pipeline` (~1000 lines): `codec/mod.rs:1-310`, `codec/filter.rs:1-52`,
   `codec/byte_shuffle.rs:1-224`, `codec/bit_shuffle.rs:1-357`.
   Consult: `context.rs:51-97`, `util/mod.rs:292-396` (AlternatingBuffers), `util/buf_pool.rs`,
   `util/aligned_vec/mod.rs`, `storage/block.rs:161-208,281-320,350-410`,
   `storage/compact.rs:298-372`, `array/compact.rs:171-351`.
   Focus: Decoder buffer parity and the new direct use of `context.decompressor` / `buffer_pool`
   (#98) - aliasing with the new read cache's pooled buffers; length check before filters and what
   `dst` holds on every error path (it may be the caller's out buffer); SIMD byte-shuffle index math
   per lanes 16/32/64 x itemsize 2/4/8/16 and both shuffle branches; `get_unchecked` bounds for tiny /
   empty inputs; bit-shuffle inverse for odd typesize and `n % 8 != 0`; every filter writes every dst
   byte; miri memcpy length assumptions.
2. `codec-archive-archive-io` (~970 lines): `archive/common.rs:1-276`, `archive/block.rs:1-515`,
